name: remote-mobile-ui
goal: One Svelte renderer picks an explicit environment adapter (Electron, Capacitor iOS, web) and shows remote connection setup and status

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Scope: explicit environment adapter (electron|capacitor|web) in the one renderer; desktop Phone access panel (enable, one-time pairing, approve with explicit local projects and agents flag, decline, revoke); phone Computer connection (link+code pairing, pending approval, online, offline cached read-only, revoked, disconnect). DTOs are backend-contract.md sections 7/8. RED on unchanged renderer (0 files changed under packages/desktop/src): bunx playwright test -c work/mobile/playwright.config.ts ui-remote-host.spec.ts ui-remote-phone.spec.ts -> 8 failed, 0 passed; first failures: html data-environment expected electron|web|capacitor received empty; region Phone access / Computer connection not found. sha256 spec files: host.spec 57e8910a, phone.spec 77cd85b9, host-fixture 47707f80, phone-fixture a9ff5bf4

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Environment adapters (selectEnvironment, Electron/Capacitor adapters, CapacitorBridgeAdapter), remoteHost/remotePhone stores, Remote* components and remote.css in packages/desktop; Capacitor config, iOS project com.dafuga.harness and HarnessRemote Swift plugin (11 files). Unsigned simulator build succeeds; app launched on iPhone 17 Pro iOS 26.5 simulator and rendered the Connect to computer gate through the real plugin. No real relay or host connection was run.
